deltas.description: Current Transformers and llama.cpp paths expose a real pre-decoder Qwen media-feature boundary; libmtmd server code forwards encoded media embeddings into decoder processing, making one-encode feature reuse physically testable.

Qwen3.5 2B and 4B share the same core 24x1024 vision tower while 0.8B uses a 12x768 tower, so visual encode cost must be benchmarked independently from total model size. Standard ViT-block arithmetic from official configs predicts the 0.8B vision core at roughly 29-30% of 2B/4B block compute at equal visual token counts, excluding preprocessing/projector/backend overhead; this is a hypothesis, not a runtime measurement.

Raw Qwen mmproj features may be poor open-set/familiarity embeddings; primary embedding research uses explicit contrastive/multi-stage adaptation, keeping a dedicated lightweight embedding baseline alive.
Recent llama.cpp Qwen3.5 multimodal issue evidence makes build/runtime flags a required causal control before interpreting visual model quality. Added runtime sanity gate and crash/recovery matrix.
Defined VisionFeatureTap as a typed physical interception point at libmtmd that preserves dissolved-Retina semantics while enabling measured decoder bypass; no new semantic service is introduced.
